units.summary: New test injects an append inside the pre-evict hook and checks the series survives eviction and WAL replay. It encodes different expectations when isolation is disabled, where the late sample is lost.
units.headline: Test: late append during selected-series compaction survives restart
units.reason: New test only; it cannot affect production behavior, though it documents the data-loss outcome when isolation is disabled.

units.summary: New test opens an appender before compaction and commits it in the pre-evict hook, asserting the series is retained and the sample survives restart. It is skipped when isolation is disabled.
units.headline: Test: pre-opened appender committing mid-compaction is not lost
units.reason: New test only; no production code is changed.

units.summary: New predicate returning true when a series has no OOO state. It replaces inline OOO checks and is used as the eviction and filter predicate for selected-series compaction.
units.headline: New predicate selects series without out-of-order data
units.reason: It gates which series are evicted from the head, so a wrong predicate can orphan OOO chunks or lose data.
focus: s.ooo == nil matches the old definition of no OOO data, including after OOO chunks have been flushed

units.summary: Extracted the stale-NaN check (float and histogram variants) from gcStaleSeries into a helper. It is also used to count stale series deleted.
units.headline: Stale-NaN check extracted into isStaleSeries helper
units.reason: The logic is identical to the removed inline condition in gcStaleSeries.

units.summary: truncateStaleSeries now takes an appendID watermark and delegates to truncateSeries. A series is evicted only if it has no OOO data, is still stale, and has no samples with appendID above the watermark. Series that received late samples stay in the head.
units.headline: Stale-series truncation now skips series with post-watermark appends
units.reason: It changes the eviction predicate and the signature, and affects data retention and WAL tombstones.
focus: how the watermark is captured in compactHeadViewLocked and whether it covers appenders opened before it
behavior when isolation is disabled, where the guard does nothing

units.summary: New eviction entry point for selected-series compaction. It evicts a series only if it has no OOO data and no sample above the appendID watermark. It does not require staleness.
units.headline: New truncation evicts selected non-stale series below the watermark
units.reason: It removes live series from the head and writes WAL tombstones, so errors lose data.
focus: a late sample committed between block write and eviction is retained, with no tombstone written
interaction with the maxt inclusive check in truncateSeries

units.summary: New helper scanning a series' in-flight append-ID ring for any ID above the watermark. It returns false when isolation is disabled because s.txs is nil.
units.headline: Helper detects samples committed after the compaction watermark
units.reason: It decides whether a series is evicted, and with isolation disabled the guard silently does nothing.
focus: the iterator loop over txIDCount matches the ring-buffer semantics of txRing
the guard only works while s.txs retains entries, so that cleanup has not dropped IDs above the watermark
